children: The company’s agentic AI engine recognized for industry innovation and impact
Paychex WISE recognized as one HR Executive’s Top HR Products of the Year in 2026

Built on Paychex's trusted HR, payroll, and workforce expertise, WISE combines embedded AI capabilities with expert guidance to proactively identify issues, automate workflows, and drive better business outcomes
ROCHESTER, N.Y., Sept. 15, 2026
, a leading provider of expert-enabled HR, payroll, and benefits, today announced that

(Workforce Intelligence Strengthened by Expertise), the company’s AI-powered intelligence engine, has been named a Top HR Product by HR Executive. WISE is one of only 14 solutions to earn the designation for 2026.

Hosted by HR Executive and HR Tech, the annual Top HR Products competition aims to uncover the most impactful and forward-thinking technologies introduced into the market over the last year. Each submission is reviewed by a panel of esteemed judges and then assessed for innovation, functionality, ease of use and value to HR organizations. After a rigorous evaluation and live product demonstration, WISE was recognized as a Top HR Product of 2026.

"The future of AI in HR is not simply providing information or answering questions — it is delivering real intelligence that can help organizations confidently take action," said Ryan Bergstrom, Chief Product and Technology Officer at Paychex. "Being named a Top HR Product winner by HR Executive – one of our industries most respected award programs – validates our vision for WISE and the value it is delivering to businesses every day. We are proud to be redefining what AI can do by combining trusted expertise, proprietary workforce insights, and agentic AI capabilities that help our customers anticipate issues, make better decisions, and complete work more efficiently."

Since its launch in May 2026, WISE has helped customers proactively prevent payroll errors and unlock operational efficiency, while also enabling Paychex service teams to focus on providing customers with higher-value support.

Specifically, Intelligent Pay Cycle, powered by WISE, continuously monitors payroll workflows for anomalies and proactively flags missing pay data, incomplete time records, and unresolved approvals before they become payroll issues. Key results to date include:
Enabled proactive payroll management, with nearly 90% of identified time and pay rate errors corrected before payroll processing day.
Reduced review and resolution times for direct deposit changes, decreasing the average turnaround from approximately three days to less than two days.

WISE represents a fundamental shift in how intelligence is applied within HR, moving from user-directed tools to an agentic platform embedded directly into HR, payroll, and workforce management workflows. WISE underpins Paychex’s strategy to power people and performance through agents, intelligence, and assistants — while seamlessly connecting customers to human expertise when it matters most. Together, these capabilities deliver actionable insights, expert guidance, and agentic automation that help organizations work faster, smarter, and more efficiently.

Industry analyst and judge Madeline Laurano said, “The most compelling HR technologies do more than just address the challenges HR teams face today – they help anticipate what’s next. This year’s Top HR Product winners show how innovation, grounded in market needs, can deliver greater efficiency, better insights and more strategic value. These are the kinds of solutions that move the industry forward and redefine what’s possible for HR.”

Paychex will be honored on Monday, October 19, during the HR Icons Awards Evening at Mandalay Bay in Las Vegas, the night before HR Tech 2026. Those attending the conference will have the opportunity to see Paychex’s award-winning WISE in action by visiting Booth #4227 during expo hours Tuesday, October 20 to Thursday, October 22.
More information about WISE and AI at Paychex is available at paychex.com/ai.
